queries.item: CREATE TABLE `?:faq_sections` ( `faq_section_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL auto_increment, `section_position` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL default '1', `company_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL, `shar_section` text NOT NULL default '', `icon_class` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL default 'A', `for_product` char(1) NOT NULL default 'N', `single` char(1) NOT NULL default 'N', `show_on_main` char(1) NOT NULL default 'Y', PRIMARY KEY (`faq_section_id`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE `?:faq_sections_descr` ( `faq_section_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL, `faq_section_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `lang_code` char(2) NOT NULL, `meta_keywords` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `meta_description` text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `page_title` text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', UNIQUE KEY `faq_section_id` (`faq_section_id`,`lang_code`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE `?:faq_questions_cp` ( `faq_question_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL auto_increment, `faq_section_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL default '0', `question_position` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL default '1', `company_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL, `qu_icon_class` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `qu_anchor` text NOT NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL default 'A', `for_product` char(1) NOT NULL default 'N', `show_on_main` char(1) NOT NULL default 'Y', PRIMARY KEY (`faq_question_id`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE `?:faq_questions_products` ( `faq_question_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL, `faq_section_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL default '0', `question_position` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL default '1', `product_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `single` char(1) NOT NULL default 'N', UNIQUE KEY `faq_question_id` (`faq_question_id`,`product_id`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;

CREATE TABLE `?:faq_questions_descr` ( `faq_question_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL, `faq_question` text NOT NULL default '', `faq_answer` text NOT NULL default '', `lang_code` char(2) NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY `faq_question_id` (`faq_question_id`,`lang_code`) ) Engine=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET UTF8;
ALTER TABLE ?:products ADD cp_fq_variation_type char(1) NOT NULL default 'M';
